d: Why was Uranus once called George? How was Neptune discovered through mathematics before being observed? This Sciencekaari episode explores the fascinating links between planets, mythology, astronomy and the periodic table.

Why does your heart race and adrenaline surge while playing a video game, even when you're safe at home? This Sciencekaari episode explores the neuroscience behind hyper-realistic games like GTA 6 and how virtual threats trigger real physical reactions.

Chayan Rastogi and Prashant Kapoor break down Team India's shocking defeat against Pakistan in the Asia Cup Rising Stars 2027, putting Tilak Varma's performance under the scanner and questioning whether the blame is being unfairly pinned on one player.

In this episode of Guest In The Newsroom, singer Lakhbir Singh Lakha speaks with Kuldeep Mishra about his musical journey and the stories behind iconic bhajans like "Pyara Saja Hai Tera Dwar Bhawani," "Maiya Ka Chola Hai Rang Lal," and "Are Dwarpalo." The conversation also touches on Khalistan, Sidhu Moose Wala, Daler Mehndi, Gulshan Kumar, and his views on the changing music industry.

Tarikh | Explore the life, legends and philosophy of Baba Keenaram, one of the most influential saints of the Aghor tradition. From Kashi to Hinglaj Mata Temple in Balochistan, discover the history of Aghor, Krim Kund and his connection with the Mughal emperor Shah Jahan.

China's growing military presence and frequent face-offs along the India-China border have raised concerns over border security. In this special conversation with Manas, Major General Sudhakar Jee (VSM), former GOC of Tawang, explains China's strategy, India's defence preparedness and the Army's response along the LAC.

Prabhat Kumar's book traces the IITs' journey from Nehru's "temples of modern India" to a global ecosystem of education and innovation, while also examining the intense academic pressure and mental health concerns behind the IIT tag. The death of IIT Bombay student Sahil Wakode has brought questions around caste, institutional mechanisms, and student welfare back into focus.

In this episode of LT Insider, Terence Lewis discusses his upcoming film Aaj Ka Mahishasur, his transition from dance to acting, and bringing the mythological figure of Mahishasur into today's context. He also opens up about his early struggles, his journey in the dance industry, and his experience facing the camera as an actor.
